eda.why: eda-/- zebrafish lose scales, fin rays, pharyngeal teeth and gill rakers (PMID 41344457); used by perturbation row P10 but not mapped in rounds 1-2

fgf20a.why: epidermal Fgf20a expression scales with amputation extent and drives the Erk size-memory gradient (PMID 42719339); used by the plan but not mapped in rounds 1-2

kcnh2b.why: paralog control for kcnh2a: the teleost whole-genome duplication means a best hit to a kcnh2a query could be the b paralog's region
